It also allows you to save your favorite poems and prose in each issue.

The POETRY Magazine app is free to download. Subscribers receive unlimited access to over 120 of the most recent issues of POETRY. A digital-only subscription is $29.99 per year. Print subscribers also get free access to everything in the app. Non-subscribers get access to the first article in each issue, all podcast episodes, and at least one complimentary issue per year.
